items.quote: the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee
items.claim: The LORD commanded Jacob to return to his country and kindred and promised to deal well with him

items.quote: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant
items.claim: God showed mercies and truth to Jacob

items.quote: with my staff I passed over this Jordan
items.claim: Jacob crossed the Jordan with his staff

items.quote: and now I am become two bands
